prior_review_verdict.response: Resolved on PR #5637 head 153e1fc8c1ac8023c18bd1ff4a2fbd65f4b71b3d (built on 3fc35127e). [P1a archive_root binding] archived_task_owner_reviewer_with_receipt_proof now takes a required expected_archive_root parameter and fails closed to ("", "") unless receipt.get("archive_root") equals it exactly. The sole call site in active_worker_governance_lease_decision computes expected_archive_root the same way it already locates the archived snapshot on disk (status_root_val + "ai-task-archive" when a configured status_root/status_file is present, else the module-global task_archive.ARCHIVE_DIR), so the receipt is always checked against the same root the caller actually read from, matching rewrite/status_projection.py's own archive_receipt_valid contract. [P1b conflicting fresh fact] Added an additional check requiring the caller's fresh terminal_facts entry's status and terminal_outcome to both be present and match the archived snapshot's own recorded status/terminal_outcome at the proven generation; a fresh fact that disagrees with what the archive itself recorded (e.g. terminal_outcome flipped from "superseded" to "completed" at the same generation) now fails closed instead of being treated as corroborating proof. No new archive/receipt store, no generation resets; only this one function and its sole call site changed. Added test_archived_task_owner_reviewer_with_receipt_proof_binds_exact_archive_root (direct positive/negative/conflicting-fact unit coverage) and test_active_worker_governance_lease_decision_rejects_foreign_root_archive_receipt (end-to-end producer/consumer regression through active_worker_governance_lease_decision with real archive files on disk) to .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py. Independently reran both reviewer reproducers against this head: /tmp/review-handoff-3fc35127-receipt-producer.py now exits 0 (foreign_receipt_root resolves to preserve/missing_or_ambiguous_task_truth, archive_receipt_valid=false) and probe_d657_classifier_receipt_binding_0132.py now exits 0 (both different_receipt_root and conflicting_fresh_fact_outcome resolve to preserve/missing_or_ambiguous_task_truth, source_unchanged=true).

defect_reproduced.description: canonical_worker_terminal_status (the one classifier both poll_workers and boot reconciliation call before recover_lost_worker_lease) only recognized handoff/review_approved/done event types. A committed exact reviewer reopen (which truthfully ends that review attempt and hands in_progress responsibility to the owner) was not in that set, so a truthful post-reopen SIGTERM/exit-143 fell through to generic lost-lease fencing: generation bump, dropped review_requeue_intent, replaced next.

changes.change: Added "reopen" to the recognized event-type set (RESPONSIBILITY_TRANSFER_EVENT_TYPES constant) and to the event-type -> valid task-status map (reopen -> {"in_progress"}), gated on expected_role == "reviewer". Fixed shared actor check so missing actor fails closed. Added self-consistent event_id check via _ai_status_activity_event_id_matches. Added worker_matches_current_task_generation check. Added review_requeue_intent cross-check requiring pending status, matching task_generation, and matching reviewer/reopened_by. Bound committed github_review_bridge to current task review bridge (head_sha, pr, actor, decision) and dispatched attempt PR delivery head_sha, rejecting conflicting present evidence. Strictly validates complete committed delivery and evidence manifest bindings against current task and dispatched snapshot.
Catches read exceptions and returns None on missing/unreadable canonical truth when status_file is configured, refusing stale task_map fallback when a row is deleted or unreadable.

Acquires canonical_task_state_lock_file(status_file, shared=True), reloads fresh canonical task and recent governance events from disk, revalidates task generation and canonical terminal status against expected outcome under lock, and atomically commits worker status = "completed" and queue event finalization.

Removed unknown-evidence fallback to True. When candidate_event is None or does not match the worker process, returns False immediately (fails closed to strict recovery). Only returns True when canonical_worker_terminal_status returns non-None, enforcing the single shared validated contract across both poll_workers and boot reconciliation call sites.

Converged onto the shared validated contract. Evaluates transfer and terminal activity before done_statuses. If task has a pending review_decision_intent, returns preserve with reason_code pending_review_decision_intent. For RESPONSIBILITY_TRANSFER_EVENT_TYPES events, delegates to canonical_worker_terminal_status: terminates with exact_worker_lifecycle_transition only when validated, and returns preserve with unvalidated_lifecycle_transition if unauthenticated or unvalidated (rejecting missing or forged event_id). For GOVERNANCE_TERMINAL_EVENT_TYPES, strictly checks process match, digest match, and authenticated actor match; recognizes task_terminal_outcome in {"cancelled", "canceled", "superseded"} alongside task_status in {"cancelled", "canceled", "superseded"}; validates generation matches against task_gen and worker_gen when resolving owner and reviewer from worker request_snapshot or archive snapshot (preventing stale archive role borrowing); terminal cancellation terminates with authorized_terminal_cancellation only when authenticated, matching generation, and issued by Human/Ops, Orchestrator, or assigned task owner/reviewer (failing closed to preserve for unconfigured actors, wrong roles, wrong generation, or missing actor; finalizing queue as cancelled).

Under lock/CAS immediately before effects, delegates to _revalidate_and_commit_worker_terminal_status before setting worker completed or finalizing queue events, eliminating stale task_map classification windows while cleanly fencing superseded workers under lock when generation or assignment drifts. Distinguishes authorized terminal cancellation from exact_worker_lifecycle_transition.

Under canonical_task_state_lock_file(status_file, shared=True) during final CAS revalidation through save_runtime_state(config, scratch), reloads fresh canonical task and verifies lease actions for deferred terminations, completed workers, and superseded workers against fresh state: revalidates deferred terminations via typed reason checks (worker_lease_is_expired, task generation advance, or authorized governance terminate decision, gated on absence of pending review_decision_intent); authorizes superseded worker queue cleanup without requiring canonical_worker_terminal_status on stale generation; and holds the canonical lock across the entire save window so concurrent writers encounter lock contention (exit 73).

Superseded-worker/queue-completed CAS branch no longer unconditionally fences on a pending review_decision_intent. When the fresh task carries a pending intent, evaluates reason-specific dead-attempt (pid_is_alive is false, or worker_process_generation_is_current is false) or expired-lease (worker_lease_is_expired) predicates alongside the pre-existing gen-fence/governance-terminate/actor-mismatch checks; the cleanup only commits when one of those applies, otherwise the live-intent fence still holds and cas_matches is set to False. review_decision_intent, task digest, generation, and review authority are never mutated by this path.

New helper called only from active_worker_governance_lease_decision's archived-snapshot fallback (the compact-terminal-fact case where the live task row has no owner/reviewer left). Only returns a non-empty (owner, reviewer) once the archived_snapshot's canonical-json sha256 matches a recorded archive_receipts[task_id].snapshot_sha256 and a matching terminal_facts[task_id] entry proves the same generation as the archived task; any missing receipt, missing fact, hash mismatch, or generation mismatch returns ("", ""), which the caller treats as still-unauthorized (falls through to "preserve"). Accepts an optional caller-supplied canonical `state` (validated directly, using a local pure _canonical_json_sha256_for_receipt_proof mirror of scripts/ai_status.py's algorithm) and otherwise falls back to a fresh ai_status.load_state() disk read via _load_ai_status_archive_provenance.

Added an optional `state` parameter (the caller's own freshly reloaded canonical task state) that is threaded into archived_task_owner_reviewer_with_receipt_proof instead of always doing a second, potentially differently-rooted disk read.

Small wrapper around load_status(config) returning None on any failure; used at all three active_worker_governance_lease_decision call sites (deferred-signal CAS gate, superseded-worker CAS branch, poll_worker_assignment_stage) to supply the same-cycle canonical state for the archive-receipt proof above.

Added a required expected_archive_root parameter; fails closed to ("", "") unless receipt.get("archive_root") equals it exactly, so a receipt recorded for a foreign archive root can no longer authorize terminal cancellation even with a matching snapshot hash and generation. Also now requires the caller's fresh terminal_facts entry's status and terminal_outcome to both be present and equal the archived snapshot's own recorded status/terminal_outcome at the proven generation, failing closed on a conflicting fresh fact (e.g. terminal_outcome diverging from what the archive itself recorded).

Its sole call into archived_task_owner_reviewer_with_receipt_proof now computes expected_archive_root the same way it already locates the archived snapshot on disk: str(status_root_val/"ai-task-archive") when a configured status_root/status_file is present, else the module-global task_archive.ARCHIVE_DIR, matching rewrite/status_projection.py's own archive_receipt_valid contract.

real_two_process_cli_taskstore_outbox_fl.detail: RealProcessReviewHandoffRecoveryFlowTests in .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py exercises 15 genuine multi-process flows with real worker_runner.py, local_stub sandbox, genuine runner exits writing runner status JSON markers, fresh supervisor process restart, and authentic queue consumer launch: (1) test_real_isolated_runner_stop_and_dispatch_flow: isolated child runner, real PID and /proc ticks, CLI ai-status.sh reopen commit, SIGTERM/exit 143, unmocked supervisor poll_workers & fresh restart reconciliation, dispatch_ready_tasks plans owner dispatch with review findings, and actual successor worker process executes verifying review_requeue_intent. (2) test_real_runner_queue_consumer_launches_exactly_one_owner_across_restart: real queue consumer process_queue launches owner worker from queued intent with captured findings across supervisor restart without duplicate launches. (3) test_real_runner_queue_receipt_restart_and_dispatch_flow: real runner exit (143), CLI reopen, unmocked poll_workers, fresh restart reconciliation, durable reserve_dispatch_plan queue receipt reservation, repeated dispatch cycle deduplication, and supervisor restart boot reconciliation preservation of the queued event to Antigravity. (4) test_two_process_ordering1_reopen_completes_before_recovery_cas: bounded overlapping processes with fail-closed dual multiprocessing.Barrier(2) synchronization, proving reopen commits before recovery CAS, recovery CAS fails safely, worker is superseded without bumping generation, and review findings remain intact. (5) test_two_process_ordering2_recovery_fences_stale_reopen_refused_by_cas: dual barrier concurrency proving recovery CAS commits first (bumping generation 1 -> 2), and concurrent stale reopen is refused by CAS preflight with exit code != 0. (6) test_two_process_ordering_handoff_completes_before_recovery_cas: dual barrier concurrency proving handoff commits before recovery CAS, worker superseded cleanly. (7) test_two_process_ordering_finalize_completes_before_recovery_cas: authentic finalize race using _child_done_finalize_worker, proving task finalized to done and archived while recovery CAS supersedes worker without lost-lease receipt. (8) test_two_process_ordering_assignment_stage_revalidation_fences_concurrent_reassign: concurrent reassignment bumps generation 1 -> 2 while assignment stage poll revalidates under lock and supersedes worker cleanly. (9) test_two_process_ordering_reassignment_fences_stale_reopen: dual barrier concurrency proving supervisor reassignment fences concurrent stale reopen, task advanced to reassigned owner. (10) test_crash_window_reopen_commit_runner_sigkill_restart: CLI reopen committed, runner abruptly killed via SIGKILL, and fresh supervisor restart boot reconciliation cleanly reaps the dead process as completed without lost-lease receipt, preserving task at generation 1. (11) test_crash_retry_window_outbox_committed_runner_terminated_receipt_retry: outbox committed, runner terminated (143), restart reconciliation, queue reservation, crash restart, repeated dispatch deduplication, and actual successor worker process execution verifying outbox reason. (12) test_two_process_ordering_reserved_phase_save_window_locks_concurrent_writer: proves canonical lock held across state save blocks concurrent writer with exit code 73. (13) test_two_process_ordering_reserved_phase_drift_fences_deferred_termination: proves canonical task mutation before phase revalidation safely sets cas_matches=False and aborts phase commit. (14) test_reserved_phase_commits_reason_specific_generation_fence_cleanup: verifies running and exited worker generation-fence cleanups commit, and unauthorized supersede is discarded. (15) test_reserved_phase_reaps_real_expired_lease_and_refuses_unauthorized_signals: tests real expired worker process termination via SIGTERM, refusal of unexpired worker termination, and refusal of termination under pending review_decision_intent.
